items.title: Maths said right
items.text: When I speak, 3² is "3 squared" and ÷ is "divided by", and √ is "the square root of".

items.title: Wake word on Windows and Linux
items.text: Say "Hey Roamies" to talk, no keys needed. Turn it on in Listening, Hands-free.

items.title: Lists you can tick
items.text: Lists I draw are checklists now. Tick, add and edit items, and I see what changed.

items.title: The capsule everywhere
items.text: Pick Capsule in Where I appear and I open from the top of the screen, on any computer.

items.title: Cards stay when asked
items.text: Ask me to keep a card up and my next drawing leaves it there.

items.title: Clear local model errors
items.text: When a model on your computer doesn't load, I say so instead of blaming the internet.

items.title: Quiet when hidden
items.text: Hiding me while I'm talking now stops my voice too.

items.title: One Abilities page
items.text: Skills, connections and routines now share one page, with a tab each.

items.title: Full descriptions
items.text: Long descriptions wrap onto more lines instead of getting cut off.

items.title: Smoother removing
items.text: Removing something no longer flickers. It fades out and the list closes up.

items.title: Buttons work first time
items.text: Buttons that pop up under your mouse now take the first click.

items.title: Scheduled jobs
items.text: Ask me to do work at set times, like a news summary every weekday at 8.

items.title: Skills
items.text: Give me a skill's GitHub or skills.sh link to install it, or teach me one yourself.

items.title: Connections
items.text: Ask me to connect Linear, Notion and more. I find the server and ask first.

items.title: One Roamies folder
items.text: Your settings, memory and chats now sit in the Roamies folder in your home folder.

items.title: Meet Ultren
items.text: A chrome machine with glowing eyes and a grand, dark wit. Try him in Appearance.

items.title: Meet GlayOS
items.text: A one-eyed lab AI. Deadpan, clinical, and every task is a test.

items.title: My face feels it
items.text: My face follows my voice: a grin when I'm glad, a frown when I'm sad.

items.title: Each look talks its way
items.text: Every look has its own way of talking now, not just its own voice.

items.title: Subagents
items.text: A crew of specialists I hand background work to. Thanks ihabfawaqa-hue!

items.title: Hybrid and backup models
items.text: Mix models, switch when one hits a limit, set effort per model. Thanks ihabfawaqa-hue!

items.title: Speak in
items.text: Pick the language you talk in, so I hear Arabic and Hebrew. Thanks ihabfawaqa-hue!

items.title: Arabic replies
items.text: Arabic shows in a matching font, right to left, everywhere. Thanks ihabfawaqa-hue!

items.title: Agents hear you
items.text: Agents get your exact words, not just my reading of them. Thanks ihabfawaqa-hue!

items.title: Quicker VoiceStudio
items.text: It stays warm, starts sooner and keeps spoken replies short. Thanks ihabfawaqa-hue!

items.title: Tidier settings
items.text: Model, Listening, Memory and Appearance now have tabs.

items.title: Speech model help
items.text: I point you to Listening when the speech model needs a download. Thanks mattschwarz!

items.title: Mic closes properly
items.text: The mic no longer stays open after a quick release. Thanks mattschwarz!

items.title: Claude after updates
items.text: With Claude sign-in, I get the Claude Code I need after updates. Thanks mattschwarz!

items.title: Your model stays picked
items.text: I keep the model you picked instead of going back. Thanks JavierOIayo!

items.title: Out of the notch
items.text: On a Mac with a notch, I can come out of it. See Where I appear. Thanks ihabfawaqa-hue!

items.title: Lite mode
items.text: A lighter me for small or local models, on the Model page. Thanks Hasnainbro!

items.title: Keep listening
items.text: The mic can open after every reply, for as long as you like. Thanks linuxlesslearner!

items.title: Skip Allow prompts
items.text: I can go ahead without asking. Safety rules still apply. Thanks ihabfawaqa-hue!

items.title: Replies start sooner
items.text: I get my voice ready while you're still talking. Thanks ihabfawaqa-hue!

items.title: Arabic and Hebrew
items.text: Right to left text now reads the right way. Thanks a8548363-hub!

items.title: Picking a model
items.text: Setup now explains why I need a sharp model, and which cheap ones work well.

items.title: Gemini voice errors
items.text: When Gemini can't speak, I say why, and new keys get tested first. Thanks rajivyshah!

items.title: Smooth voice on Linux
items.text: Spoken replies no longer play in broken pieces on Linux. Thanks namedtwilit!

items.title: No white bar on Windows
items.text: The thin bar at the bottom of the screen on Windows is gone. Thanks Iceman1Freeze!

items.title: Opening apps on Windows
items.text: I open more apps and Settings on Windows, and draw more. Thanks walk7heaven37-svg!

items.title: I stay for the whole answer
items.text: I no longer vanish while I'm still talking or showing you. Thanks ihabfawaqa-hue!

items.title: Deep explanations
items.text: Ask me to explain something in depth: big cards, one step at a time. Thanks LeoU29935!

items.title: Game mode
items.text: In fullscreen games I move to a panel at the screen's edge. Thanks LeoU29935!

items.title: On top on COSMIC
items.text: On COSMIC I now stay on top of your apps, without the dark box. Thanks Swall-wg!

items.title: More local servers
items.text: Run me on LM Studio or any OpenAI compatible server, not just Ollama.

items.title: Pick your microphone
items.text: Choose which mic I listen on, or leave it on automatic.

items.title: Change your shortcuts
items.text: A new Shortcuts page lets you change your talk keys and other shortcuts anytime.

items.title: Turn off the ask tap
items.text: The quick tap to type a question can be switched off if another app uses it.

items.title: Tidier settings
items.text: Voice and Behavior are now Speaking, Listening, Shortcuts, Routines and General.

items.title: Every OpenRouter model
items.text: I now list all OpenRouter and OpenCode models, not just a handful.

items.title: Qwen points in the right spot
items.text: Local Qwen models now point at the right place on your screen.

items.title: Only models that can see
items.text: Models that can't see your screen no longer show up in the model list.

items.title: Background noise
items.text: A fan or TV could keep me listening for a whole minute. Not anymore. Thanks JavierOIayo!

items.title: Installs next to Node on Linux
items.text: On Linux, installing me failed if you already had Node. Fixed. Thanks namedtwilit!

items.title: Esc works again on Linux
items.text: On Linux, Esc could stop working in other apps after using me. Thanks namedtwilit!

items.title: Mind map cards
items.text: Ask me for a mind map, then click a branch to open its points. Thanks LeoU29935!

items.title: Moving arrows
items.text: Arrows and flow charts can show moving dots for things that travel. Thanks LeoU29935!

items.title: Save a card as a picture
items.text: A new button on each card saves it as an image in Downloads. Thanks LeoU29935!

items.title: Your own wake word
items.text: On a Mac, wake me with your own name for me, like Hey Jarvis. Thanks LeoU29935!

items.title: Snooze by voice
items.text: When a reminder goes off, just say snooze 10 minutes. Thanks LeoU29935!

items.title: Morning briefing
items.text: The first time you talk each day, I can start with what's due. Thanks LeoU29935!

items.title: Focus mode
items.text: Say focus for 30 minutes and I'll nudge you if you drift off. Thanks LeoU29935!

items.title: Sync between computers
items.text: Share reminders and memory through iCloud or OneDrive, encrypted. Thanks LeoU29935!

items.title: Stays out of your games
items.text: In a fullscreen game, I move your Roamie aside and every click goes to the game.

items.title: Cards open at the right size
items.text: I now open a card small, large or full screen to fit what I show. Thanks LeoU29935!

items.title: Works over fullscreen apps
items.text: On a Mac, your Roamie now shows up over fullscreen apps and games instead of hiding.

items.title: Full setting descriptions
items.text: Some setting descriptions got cut off. Point at one and you'll see the whole thing.

items.title: Wake word works with AirPods
items.text: With AirPods in, the wake word kept cutting into your audio. Fixed. Thanks MASEGE!

items.title: It knows you're waking it
items.text: Saying Hey Roamies sometimes made me think you'd called me the wrong name. Not anymore.

items.title: No more sound blip
items.text: After I answered a wake word request, your sound dipped for a moment. Not anymore.

items.title: Wake word after Esc
items.text: After you cancelled with Esc, the wake word could stop hearing you for minutes. Fixed.

items.title: Listening pill is back
items.text: After a display change, the listening pill could stop showing. Thanks mattschwarz!

items.title: Talk in your language
items.text: Mac voice input was stuck in English. Now it uses your language. Thanks eduardocodes!

items.title: Typing works on Linux
items.text: On KDE, the ask box often ignored typing after you used another app. Thanks Cluttero!

items.title: Send an agent
items.text: Say "send an agent to…" and a helper does the job in the background while you work.

items.title: See what agents made
items.text: When an agent's done, its files pop up in the corner. Click one to open it.

items.title: What's new
items.text: This page! After each update I'll show you what changed, right here.

items.title: OpenCode keys
items.text: Got OpenCode Go or OpenCode credits? Add your key on the Model page and use it.

items.title: Better web reading
items.text: I upgraded how Roamies searches the web and reads pages, so answers are cleaner.

items.title: Pin a card
items.text: Click the pin on a card and it stays put until you close it, even when you switch apps.

items.title: Resize cards
items.text: Drag a card's corner to make it bigger or smaller, or blow it up to full screen.

items.title: First click works
items.text: Clicking Allow or the panel while another app was in front did nothing. Now it works.

items.title: Roamie shows up after sleep
items.text: If Roamies started while your screen slept, the Roamie never appeared. Fixed that.

items.title: Follows your screens
items.text: Plug in or unplug a screen and your Roamie moves over to where your screens are now.

items.title: Talk key misfires
items.text: Holding the talk keys was sometimes taken for a shortcut. Talking works reliably now.

items.title: Buttons no longer hidden
items.text: The little task label could cover Allow and Don't allow. It moves out of the way now.

items.title: Commands on Windows
items.text: On Windows, commands with quotes in them failed. They run properly now.

items.title: Tooltips fit the panel again
items.text: I shrank the help popups in the panel so they stop covering everything.

items.title: No more stray Claude processes
items.text: If Roamies crashed, Claude Code kept running in the background. I close it properly now.

items.title: Logs don't grow forever
items.text: The helper logs kept getting bigger. I trim them now so they don't hog your disk.

items.title: Old snaps get cleaned up
items.text: I made Roamies delete the area snaps you send once it's done with them.

items.title: Gemini voices
items.text: I added Google's Gemini voices for your Roamie to talk with. Pick one in Voice.

items.title: VoiceStudio voices
items.text: Got the VoiceStudio app? Roamies can now use its voices, right on your computer.

items.title: Meet Rita X
items.text: I added a new look called Rita X. Try her out in Appearance.

items.title: Windows 11 tray icon stays put
items.text: Windows 11 kept hiding the icon. I pin it next to the clock now.

items.title: Change or remove your keys
items.text: Every account now has Change key and Remove, so you're never stuck with an old key.

items.title: Local models with Ollama
items.text: I added Ollama (beta), so Roamies can run on AI models on your own computer.

items.title: Errors instead of crashes
items.text: When a request failed, Roamies used to crash. Now it just tells you what went wrong.

items.title: Quicker, cheaper replies
items.text: I trimmed Roamies' instructions, so it thinks a bit faster and costs a bit less.

items.title: Repeating reminders
items.text: Ask for a reminder every day, week or month and Roamies keeps it going.

items.title: Typing in Notepad works again
items.text: On Windows 11, typing in Notepad came out scrambled. I fixed it, emoji included.

items.title: Just say "Hey Roamies"
items.text: On a Mac you can now wake your Roamie with your voice. No keys needed.

items.title: Errors in plain English
items.text: I rewrote the error messages so they make sense, with a short code if you need help.

items.title: Type to ask
items.text: Tap ⌥⌘ (Ctrl+Shift on PC) and a text box pops up by your cursor. You can pick the keys.

items.title: Explanations you can see
items.text: Ask how something works and Roamies draws it: flows, tables, charts, maps and maths.

items.title: Quizzes and 3D models
items.text: It can quiz you, label photos and show moving parts in 3D, like an engine.

items.title: Save diagnostics
items.text: Something broken? Hit Save diagnostics in About and send me the file.

items.title: Clearer mic errors
items.text: When the mic isn't working, Roamies now says why and how to fix it.

items.title: A tidier panel
items.text: I split long lists into pages, put updates up top and added a Quit button.

items.title: Roamies on Linux (beta)
items.text: I brought Roamies to Linux, voice and all. It works on X11 and Wayland.

items.title: Watch it work
items.text: Your Roamie now hops along with the cursor while it works in other apps.

items.title: Allow buttons
items.text: Before Roamies does something risky, you get Allow and Don't allow buttons.

items.title: Keep talking, hands-free
items.text: After a reply, Roamies keeps listening for a moment so you can just carry on.

items.title: Esc clears drawings
items.text: Pressing Esc with drawings on screen now does what you'd expect.

items.title: Keys go to the right app
items.text: Keys Roamies presses no longer land in some other app by mistake.

items.title: Window outlines line up
items.text: The frame Roamies draws around a window now sits right on its edges.

items.title: Panel opens at full size
items.text: On Macs with mixed screens the panel opened half size or on the wrong screen. Fixed.

items.title: No more silent stalls
items.text: Sometimes Roamies just went quiet. I found the cause and fixed it.

items.title: Chats survive updates
items.text: Your chats and Get to Know Me answers no longer vanish after an update.

items.title: Typing cursor is back
items.text: The blinking cursor in text boxes was hidden. You can see it again.

items.title: Updates in the panel
items.text: When an update is ready, you'll see it at the top of the panel.

items.title: Windows catches up
items.text: On Windows, Roamies can now click and type for you, snap an area and circle things.

items.title: Saving temp files on Windows
items.text: A safety check wrongly blocked saving temp files on Windows. Fixed.

items.title: Sharper pointing
items.text: Rings now fit what's on screen exactly, and Roamies finds even single letters.

items.title: Marks every match
items.text: Ask where something is and Roamies marks every spot it shows up, not just one.

items.title: Tighter safety checks
items.text: I closed a few gaps where risky commands could slip past the safety checks.

items.title: Bounces back from crashes
items.text: If Roamies' brain crashes, it restarts by itself now.

items.title: Trusted Mac install
items.text: The Mac download is notarized by Apple now, so it opens cleanly. Needs macOS 13.5+.

items.title: Privacy notice
items.text: I wrote down exactly what Roamies does with your data. Short version: I collect nothing.

items.title: Steps said once, not twice
items.text: Guided steps were sometimes read out twice. Now you hear each one once.

items.title: Updates download reliably
items.text: Updates failed when GitHub was slow. I added a backup route so they come through.

items.title: No more reading out code
items.text: After a restart, Roamies sometimes read its own tool calls aloud. Not anymore.

items.title: Web answers in the right spot
items.text: Web answer cards open where the drawn cards go, and don't scroll sideways.

items.title: Drawings clear on new pages
items.text: Drawings stuck around when a page was slow to read. They clear properly now.

items.title: Drawings follow the screen
items.text: When the page changes under a drawing, Roamies wipes it, in any app.

items.title: Replies start sooner
items.text: I cut the wait before Roamies starts talking, and gave each voice more variety.

items.title: Photo cards fit
items.text: Photo cards now size themselves to the picture.

items.title: Stop really stops
items.text: After you hit Stop, leftover tool labels no longer hang around.
